title: The Bone Furnace
text: Devils feed bones into a great furnace by the barrowful, and it breathes the heat of the Pit in long red gusts. Ash falls like snow around it. Its stokers lean on their shovels between loads, yawning, bored out of their minds.

options.label: Sneak past while the stokers work, and pray none of them looks up.

outcomes.text: You slip past, sweating, eyes stinging with ash. Not one of them looked up.
A stoker looks up with a grin. It is no longer bored.

options.label: The shrewdest bribes the stokers with gossip, the only coin the bored will take.

outcomes.text: They gasp at every rival's shame. Waving you through, they are already retelling it to one another.

options.label: Smash the furnace, and let the Pit go cold for once.

outcomes.text: It goes out with a roar. The devils who fed it are not bored any longer.
